<blockquote>
<p>很喜欢的靶机，有效暴露了自己的不足，里面的兔子洞基本上全部踩了一遍，所以写一下这篇wp兼笔记</p>
<p>感想：打靶很多时候是反直觉的，有的时候不能基于感觉，或者说觉得概率很小就不去尝试，它是一个严谨的，纯粹理性的过程</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="wp部分">wp部分</h2>
<h3 id="nmap">nmap</h3>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay/stapter]
└─$ nmap -sT -p- 192.168.113.240 -oA nmapscan/ports
Starting Nmap 7.95 ( https://nmap.org ) at 2025-10-15 09:52 EDT

<p><strong>awk剪切端口</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay/stapter]
└─$ port=$(cat nmapscan/ports.nmap | grep open | awk -F '/' '{print $1}'|paste -sd ',')
</code></pre>

<p>这里可以看到ftp可以匿名访问</p>
<p>53端口版本是 dnsmasq 2.75，searchsploit有漏洞，但是拒绝服务攻击不可利用</p>
<p>12380的title处,提到了tim这个人名，记录到用户名字典中</p>
<p><strong>nmap脚本扫描</strong></p>
<h3 id="信息收集">信息收集</h3>
<p>ftp匿名访问</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ ftp 192.168.113.240      
Connected to 192.168.113.240.
220-
220-|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
220-| Harry, make sure to update the banner when you get a chance to show who has access here |
220-|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
220-
220 
Name (192.168.113.240:kali): anonymous
331 Please specify the password.
Password: 
230 Login successful.
Remote system type is UNIX.
Using binary mode to transfer files.
</code></pre>
<p>成功访问，这里有个人名harry，记录到用户名字典中</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">200 PORT command successful. Consider using PASV.
150 Here comes the directory listing.
-rw-r--r--    1 0        0             107 Jun 03  2016 note
226 Directory send OK.
ftp&gt; get note
local: note remote: note
200 PORT command successful. Consider using PASV.
150 Opening BINARY mode data connection for note (107 bytes).
100% |**********************************************************|   107       15.70 KiB/s    00:00 ETA
226 Transfer complete.
107 bytes received in 00:00 (9.05 KiB/s)
</code></pre>
<p>确认没有其他文件后退出</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ cat note                 
Elly, make sure you update the payload information. Leave it in your FTP account once your are done, John.
</code></pre>
<p>Elly和john加入用户名字典，这里提到让elly更改ftp中信息，猜测ftp还可以用elly登录</p>
<p>但是信息收集到后期（包括用户名字典和其他hint），还是怎么都爆破不出来ftp</p>
<p>继续进行信息收集，</p>
<p>列出smb服务器上的共享资源：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ smbclient  -L //192.168.113.240  
Password for [WORKGROUP\kali]:

	Sharename       Type      Comment
	---------       ----      -------
	print$          Disk      Printer Drivers
	kathy           Disk      Fred, What are we doing here?
	tmp             Disk      All temporary files should be stored here
	IPC$            IPC       IPC Service (red server (Samba, Ubuntu))
Reconnecting with SMB1 for workgroup listing.

	Server               Comment
	---------            -------

	Workgroup            Master
	---------            -------
	WORKGROUP            RED

</code></pre>
<p>-L: “List” 的意思，表示列出目标主机上的可用共享资源（如共享文件夹、打印机等）。</p>
<p>这里的kathy和tmp是可访问的文件共享目录</p>
<p>访问指定的文件共享目录：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ smbclient  //192.168.113.240/kathy
Password for [WORKGROUP\kali]:
Try "help" to get a list of possible commands.
smb: \&gt; ls
  .                                   D        0  Fri Jun  3 12:52:52 2016
  ..                                  D        0  Mon Jun  6 17:39:56 2016
  kathy_stuff                         D        0  Sun Jun  5 11:02:27 2016
  backup                              D        0  Sun Jun  5 11:04:14 2016

		19478204 blocks of size 1024. 16309640 blocks available
smb: \&gt; 

</code></pre>
<p>里面东西不多，全dump下来：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">smb: \&gt; cd kathy_stuff\
smb: \kathy_stuff\&gt; ls
  .                                   D        0  Sun Jun  5 11:02:27 2016
  ..                                  D        0  Fri Jun  3 12:52:52 2016

smb: \kathy_stuff\&gt; cd ../
smb: \&gt; ls
  .                                   D        0  Fri Jun  3 12:52:52 2016
  ..                                  D        0  Mon Jun  6 17:39:56 2016
  kathy_stuff                         D        0  Sun Jun  5 11:02:27 2016
  backup                              D        0  Sun Jun  5 11:04:14 2016

		19478204 blocks of size 1024. 16309632 blocks available

  .                                   D        0  Sun Jun  5 11:04:14 2016

Get file wordpress-4.tar.gz? y
getting file \backup\wordpress-4.tar.gz of size 6321767 as wordpress-4.tar.gz (796.4 KiloBytes/sec) (average 792.7 KiloBytes/sec)
smb: \backup\&gt; 

</code></pre>
<p>查看，没有发现什么很有价值的线索，把kathy加入用户名字典</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ cat todo-list.txt
I'm making sure to backup anything important for Initech, Kathy

</code></pre>
<p>3306端口：无未授权访问</p>
<p>两个web端口均没有扫出来什么很有用的信息</p>
<p>在12380端口处源码注释：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">&lt;!-- A message from the head of our HR department, Zoe, if you are looking at this, we want to hire you! --&gt;
&lt;!--   You can change the black color for the filter with those colors: blue, green, red, orange       --&gt;
&lt;!--  H1 can have 2 designs: "logo" and "logo cursive"           --&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>增加用户名zoe,按注释改了一下前端，没什么信息</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ curl -I http://192.168.113.240:12380
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 14:38:41 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.18 (Ubuntu)
Last-Modified: Fri, 03 Jun 2016 16:55:33 GMT
ETag: "6a16a-53462974b46e8"
Accept-Ranges: bytes
Content-Length: 434538
Dave: Soemthing doesn't look right here
Connection: close
Content-Type: text/htm
</code></pre>
<p>这里有一个自定义的dave,加入字典</p>
<p>666端口：这个nmap没有扫出来是什么服务，但是是开放的</p>
<p>使用nc/telnet尝试访问：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">telnet 192.168.113.240 666
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-plain">

</code></pre>
<p>connected to...:TCP三次握手成功，建立了连接</p>
<p>这里可以看到，由于 终端默认以文本（UTF-8）显示接收到的数据。<strong>如果远端发来的不是文本而是二进制数据（例如图片、压缩包、加密流、音频或其它二进制协议），终端会把不可打印字节显示为乱七八糟的字符或问号</strong></p>
<p>开头和结尾的片段都有message2.jpg</p>
<p>怀疑远端发送的是jpeg文件或jpeg文件名的二进制流</p>
<p>把输出的数据保存到bin中然后工具识别</p>
<p>（这里注意nc比telnet好，telnet好像操作起来有问题）</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">nc 192.168.113.240 666 &gt;output.bin
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ nc 192.168.113.240 666 &gt;output.bin 
                                                                                                       
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ file output.bin    
output.bin: Zip archive data, made by v3.0 UNIX, extract using at least v2.0, last modified Jun 03 2016 16:03:08, uncompressed size 12821, method=deflate

</code></pre>
<p>发现是一个zip文件</p>
<p>使用xxd看十六进制和可打印文本</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">xxd -l 128 output.bin    # 显示前128字节的16进制与可打印文本
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-plain">00000000: 504b 0304 1400 0200 0800 6480 c348 70df  PK........d..Hp.
00000010: 1581 aa2c 0000 1532 0000 0c00 1c00 6d65  ...,...2......me
00000020: 7373 6167 6532 2e6a 7067 5554 0900 032b  ssage2.jpgUT...+
00000030: 9c51 574a 9c51 5775 780b 0001 04f5 0100  .QWJ.QWux.......
00000040: 0004 1400 0000 ad7a 0b54 13e7 beef 5094  .......z.T....P.
00000050: 8888 4140 a220 19ab 5554 c454 11a9 1032  ..A@. ..UT.T...2
00000060: 3e8a d452 444b 1585 4a6a a922 444c 5b45  &gt;..RDK..Jj."DL[E
00000070: a20c 1914 303c c4b4 b5ca ae6e 898a 8a56  ....0&lt;.....n...V

</code></pre>
<p>查到这是zip的文件头，所以这是一个包含message2.jpg的压缩包</p>
<p>查看内部文件列表：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ unzip -l output.bin              

Archive:  output.bin
  Length      Date    Time    Name
---------  ---------- -----   ----
    12821  2016-06-03 11:03   message2.jpg
---------                     -------
    12821                     1 file
                                        
</code></pre>
<p>解压缩：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ unzip output.bin                 
Archive:  output.bin
  inflating: message2.jpg            
                                                                                                       
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ ls
message2.jpg  note  output.bin  stapter  todo-list.txt  vsftpd.conf  wordpress-4.tar.gz

</code></pre>
<p>查看图片：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3527808/202511/3527808-20251107220645520-1708859781.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>还是没什么信息，把scott加入字典</p>
<p>检查exiftool:</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ exiftool  message2.jpg

<p>contact:这里说get a cookie,这里又找了一会，没找到线索</p>
<p>然后进行binwalk查是否有嵌入的二进制，无线索</p>
<p>steghide查隐写</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ steghide info message2.jpg        
"message2.jpg":
  format: jpeg
  capacity: 318.0 Byte
Try to get information about embedded data ? (y/n) y
Enter passphrase: 

</code></pre>
<p>看起来可能有隐写，使用stegseek，分别用之前收集的字典（除了用户名还有一些值得注意的信息），rockyou.txt爆破，均失败</p>
<p>然后这里一直没打出来，经过一番搜索</p>
<p>关于ftp爆破，有一个参数-e nsr</p>
<p>基于英语国家的密码习惯</p>
<p>这是hydra的额外尝试，尝试空密码，用户名作密码，用户名反转作密码</p>
<p>知道了这个参数，重新之前的ftp爆破</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ hydra -L u.txt -e nsr ftp://192.168.113.240
Hydra v9.5 (c) 2023 by van Hauser/THC &amp; David Maciejak - Please do not use in military or secret service organizations, or for illegal purposes (this is non-binding, these *** ignore laws and ethics anyway).

Hydra (https://github.com/vanhauser-thc/thc-hydra) starting at 2025-10-15 11:22:41
[DATA] max 16 tasks per 1 server, overall 16 tasks, 105 login tries (l:35/p:3), ~7 tries per task
[DATA] attacking ftp://192.168.113.240:21/
[21][ftp] host: 192.168.113.240   login: elly   password: ylle
1 of 1 target successfully completed, 1 valid password found
Hydra (https://github.com/vanhauser-thc/thc-hydra) finished at 2025-10-15 11:23:05

</code></pre>
<p>不得不说，以前真不知道国外有这种设置密码的习惯，这个参数的使用需要加入到攻击链中</p>
<p>ssh碰撞，elly无法登录</p>
<p>进去之后逐个查看，发现passwd可读，拿下来看</p>
<p>追加到自己的字典里</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ cat passwd | grep -E '/bin/bash|/bin/sh|/bin/zsh' | awk -F ':' '{print $1}' &gt;&gt;u.txt 
</code></pre>
<p>处于严谨性，由于拿到了新的用户名，不排除再爆一次能有别的ftp用户密码爆出的可能</p>
<p>还是先测nsr:</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ hydra -L u.txt -e nsr ftp://192.168.113.240
Hydra v9.5 (c) 2023 by van Hauser/THC &amp; David Maciejak - Please do not use in military or secret service organizations, or for illegal purposes (this is non-binding, these *** ignore laws and ethics anyway).

Hydra (https://github.com/vanhauser-thc/thc-hydra) starting at 2025-10-15 11:41:27
[DATA] max 16 tasks per 1 server, overall 16 tasks, 183 login tries (l:61/p:3), ~12 tries per task
[DATA] attacking ftp://192.168.113.240:21/
[21][ftp] host: 192.168.113.240   login: elly   password: ylle
[21][ftp] host: 192.168.113.240   login: SHayslett   password: SHayslett
1 of 1 target successfully completed, 2 valid passwords found
Hydra (https://github.com/vanhauser-thc/thc-hydra) finished at 2025-10-15 11:42:06

</code></pre>
<p>还真的有一个</p>
<p>继续处于严谨性，再ssh碰撞一次</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ ssh SHayslett@192.168.113.240
-----------------------------------------------------------------
~          Barry, don't forget to put a message here           ~
-----------------------------------------------------------------
SHayslett@192.168.113.240's password: 
Welcome back!


SHayslett@red:~$ 

</code></pre>
<p>还真给登上了，所以打靶一定要严谨</p>
<h2 id="提权">提权</h2>
<p>开始枚举</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/PG/replayplay]
└─$ ssh SHayslett@192.168.113.240
-----------------------------------------------------------------
~          Barry, don't forget to put a message here           ~
-----------------------------------------------------------------
SHayslett@192.168.113.240's password: 
Welcome back!


SHayslett@red:~$ sudo -l

We trust you have received the usual lecture from the local System
Administrator. It usually boils down to these three things:

    #1) Respect the privacy of others.
    #2) Think before you type.
    #3) With great power comes great responsibility.

[sudo] password for SHayslett: 

Sorry, try again.
[sudo] password for SHayslett: 
Sorry, try again.
[sudo] password for SHayslett: 
Sorry, user SHayslett may not run sudo on red.
SHayslett@red:~$ find / -perm -u=s -type f 2&gt;/dev/null
/usr/bin/newuidmap
/usr/bin/chsh
/usr/bin/sudo
/usr/bin/chfn
/usr/bin/pkexec
/usr/bin/newgidmap
/usr/bin/at
/usr/bin/passwd
/usr/bin/newgrp
/usr/bin/gpasswd
/usr/bin/ubuntu-core-launcher
/usr/lib/openssh/ssh-keysign
/usr/lib/eject/dmcrypt-get-device
/usr/lib/policykit-1/polkit-agent-helper-1
/usr/lib/i386-linux-gnu/lxc/lxc-user-nic
/usr/lib/dbus-1.0/dbus-daemon-launch-helper
/usr/lib/authbind/helper
/bin/mount
/bin/umount
/bin/ping
/bin/fusermount
/bin/ping6
/bin/su

</code></pre>
<p>suid暂时没找到可利用的，做到这里，我突然想起了之前的passwd,用户名那么多属实罕见</p>
<p>根据之前的经验（我之前的wp可能提到过）</p>
<p>用户特别多的靶机，在/home里递归查找密码一定是一个好的思路</p>
<p>于是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">SHayslett@red:~$ grep -R -i 'pass' /home 2&gt;/dev/null
/home/peter/.zcompdump:'chpass' '_chsh'
/home/peter/.zcompdump:'passwd' '_users'
/home/peter/.zcompdump:'systemd-ask-password' '_systemd'
/home/peter/.zcompdump:'systemd-tty-ask-password-agent' '_systemd'
/home/peter/.zcompdump:'yppasswd' '_yp'
/home/JKanode/.bash_history:sshpass -p thisimypassword ssh JKanode@localhost
/home/JKanode/.bash_history:apt-get install sshpass
/home/JKanode/.bash_history:sshpass -p JZQuyIN5 peter@localhost

</code></pre>
<p>成功找到了别的用户的密码</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">SHayslett@red:~$ su - peter
Password:
